Commentary.Commentary: Right then! It brings us to the close of this run-fest. What this win has done is, it has kept the tri-series alive and kicking with each team winning one and losing the other. This is going to be fun. The 4th match is between Sri Lanka and India at the same venue on 12th March at 1900 Local (1330 GMT). Will Sri Lanka be able to recover from this defeat? Will the Indians take their revenge for their opening loss? We shall find out. Before we leave, you can catch some Test cricket action from the ongoing South Africa-Australia series. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

Victorious Bangladesh skipper, Mahmudullah starts by saying it was a game of nerves and is happy to come out on top. Reckons his decision to bowl first paid off. Credits his openers for giving them a good solid start and then continues to praise Rahim for taking them over the line. On sending Das ahead of Sarkar, he informs they had a feeling that Sri Lanka might bring Akila Dananjaya early and hence the decision.

Sri Lanka skipper, Dinesh Chandimal calls it a good game of cricket. Admits that Bangladesh were the better team but doesn't lose hope. He is confident of his boys coming back strong. Feels the wicket was excellent for batting as it remained the same throughout the course of the match. Opines they didn't execute their plans while bowling but is once again hopeful of doing better in the next game.

Man of the Match, Mushfiqur Rahim thanks the Almighty first up. He is short of words at the moment and can't believe to have taken his team over the line. States they needed this win badly. Gives it to Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das for setting it up. Dedicates this knock to his newly born son. Informs he has recovered from the cramp that he suffered while batting.

Sri Lanka, well, they will be really disappointed with their effort with the ball. The batters once again did their job but the bowling just couldn't come to the fore. All their bowlers were found wanting against the onslaught and their figures show how they wilted under pressure. Perera was good to start with, but the no ball that he bowled in his third over just took him off his radar. A lot of work to do for the Lankans as this loss will take some time for them to digest. Roshan Abeysinghe is ready with the presentation...

As it is said there comes a stage when the game doesn't take time to turn on its head. With just 22 needed from 16 balls, Mahmudullah departed and Sabbir Rahman's run out followed next. It all came down to 19 from the last 2 overs but a cool-headed Rahim didn't panic and safely gunned the 4th highest successful run chase in T20Is. His scintillating knock of an unbeaten 72 from 35 balls comprised of 5 fours and 4 sixes, stupendous stuff!

However, Sri Lanka through Perera and Pradeep, got back in the game as they were able to get rid of both the openers in quick time. Bangladesh then needed 112 in 60 balls and then arrived the veteran, Mushfiqur Rahim. He looked confident from the moment he stepped in and wasn't afraid to play his natural game. Firstly, he got some assistance from Sarkar (who was struggling) and then with his skipper, Mahmudullah. The quickfire 42-run stand with the latter somewhat tilted the game in their favor.

After being thrashed and swatted around the park in the first innings, the visitors needed a blazing start. An inspiring move to send Liton Das ahead of Sarkar to open the innings with Tamim Iqbal worked wonders. The duo did just what Sri Lanka did in the series opener against India - taking the attack to the opposition in the Powerplay. 74/1 is what they got in the first 6 overs and that set the tone for the run chase.

What a match, what a chase! Mushfiqur Rahim, please take a bow! He has got every reason to show his emotions and he isn't shy of doing it. The entire Bangladesh team barges towards him for a hug. Epic scenes in Colombo and this win will be a big boost to Bangladesh's confidence.

BANGLADESH HAVE PULLED OFF THEIR HIGHEST SUCCESSFUL RUN CHASE IN T20IS! The little man has done it for his side! Rahim is all charged up, he lets out a huge roar right in the face of Perera and then does a cobra dance by looking at his dugout. Ball - A low full toss on middle, clipped away through mid-wicket by Mushfiqur to see his side through.

Sloppy from Gunathilaka and the scores are level now! Very full on middle, Rahim smartly nudges it with soft hands towards mid on and calls for two. Danushka charges towards the ball from long on but he takes his eyes off the ball and ends up conceding another. Right then, Bangladesh can't lose now. Will he go for the glory hit?

FOUR! Away shes goes! Good length ball, sprayed wider outside off, Rahim makes room but then realizes he has to reach out for that one. He does and gets it over backward point for a boundary. The Bangladesh dugout is all pumped up. What's coming up next?

Fuller in length and outside off, Rahim makes room and pierces it past the diving cover fielder. Once it beat the fielder there, it seemed like a boundary but there is Akila Dananjaya in the deep who keeps them down to a couple.
9 to get off the final 6 balls. Last-over thriller is what we have. Thisara Perera is given the responsibility. Rahim on strike.
Back of a length delivery on middle, clipped with soft hands towards mid-wicket for a single.
Chandimal, Perera and Pradeep are seen having a mini-conference. What is it about?

SIX! That will do! That will do! Rahim, what a hit! Pradeep flings a full toss on the stumps! Any guesses what the next result is? Rahim deposits it high and handsome over the deep mid-wicket fence for half a dozen.
Could have been another run out here! Hasan swings wildly across the line, it goes off the pads towards point. The fielder has a shy at the striker's end but he misses. A leg bye taken.
Superb from Nuwan! Another one on a fuller length on the stumps, MR digs it out to long on for a single.
Mehidy Hasan is the new man in.

OUT! Bull's eye! Brilliant from Thisara, lazy from Sabbir! Very full on off, Sabbir drives it towards mid off and sets off. Perera collects the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end as Sabbir just gives up. Still they refer it upstairs and replays find Sabbir well short of his crease.
Bull's eye from Thisara Perera. He has knocked the stumps at the bowler's end and Sabbir Rahman seems to be a goner here. In fact, he is already walking off.
Into the blockhole! Rahim could only jam it out towards mid-wicket for one.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl the penultimate over.

A dot to finish! Fuller in length, right at the base of the stumps. Sabbir gets across and works it straight to the man at mid-wicket. 8 runs and a big wicket of Mahmudullah off it. The equation is 19 runs off 12 balls.
Full toss, tailing back in on middle, Mushfiqur milked down to long on for one.
Low full toss outside off, Rahim drills it past cover and scampers across for a brace.
Sabbir Rahman is the next man in.

OUT! In the air... gone! Chameera with a breakthrough! The crowd has found its voice back. Turning point in this chase? Let's wait and see. Chameera does Mahmudullah in with a slower ball who swings early and ends up dragging it on the inner half over square leg. Kusal Mendis from deep square leg sprints in and takes a wonderful catch. 22 needed off 15 balls.
Jumps out of the crease and flat-bats it over extra cover for one.

FOUR! Cracked! Short delivery, outside off, Rahim gets on top of the bounce and cuts it fiercely through point. Kusal Perera in the deep is a bit sloppy as he lets the ball through him to the fence. That's fifty for Mushfiqur in just 24 balls, well played. Can he take his side home?
27 needed off 18 now. Dushmantha Chameera is the one to have a go now. 36 is what he has given in three overs. Time to redeem?
Very full on middle, knocked down to long off for a couple. 13 off the over again. Good one for Bangladesh!
Another chance of a run out! Rahim pushes it towards Thisara Perera at covers and sets off. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.

SIX! Up and over the long on fielder! Bangladesh are in the hunt, folks! Rahim, you little beauty! Gets across to a tossed up ball, takes his front leg out of the way and smacks it over long on for a biggie.

Good running again! Tossed up delivery outside off, Rahim unfurls a reverse sweep but doesn't get it where he intended to. Gets it over extra cover and calls for two. Kusal Mendis from the deep fires in a throw at the striker's end. Direct hit would have made things interesting. But for now, two taken.
Flighted ball outside off, Mahmudullah gets down and lofts it over extra cover for another single.
Tossed up delivery around middle, driven down to long on for one.
Jeevan Mendis is asked to bowl now. 40 needed in 24 balls.

FOUR! Full toll off the Free Hit! Stays deep in the crease, expecting a slower back of a length ball and pulls it behind square on the leg side to end the over with a boundary. 18 coming off it, the no ball has hurt Sri Lanka here.
Free Hit coming up. Will Mahmudullah make the most of it?

SIX! No ball and it's a biggie! This will help Bangladesh! The ball seems to have slipped out of Perera's hands but Mahmudullah doesn't let it go waste. He thumps it down over the long on fielder and picks up a maximum.

Good effort delivery! Perera bends his back and generates extra bounce. Mahmudullah looks to pull but fails to get going with the shot. The Bangladesh captain is not amazed as he wanted this to be given as a wide.
Fuller delivery, Thisara rolls his fingers over the ball. The batsman waits for it as he drills it towards sweeper cover and gets two to his tally.

Was that off the bat? Length delivery on middle and leg, Mahmudullah walks across to paddle it but it goes off something into the gloves of the keeper. They keep appealing but the umpire shakes his head. Chandimal and Perera have a talk regarding the review but they opt against it. Good call from both Sri Lanka and the umpire as the replays show it brushed the thigh pad.
Wide! Good length delivery delivery down the leg side, the Bangla skipper tries to clip it away but fails to get any wood on it.
Mistimed shot! Back of a length on middle, Mahmudullah looks to pull it away but gets it off the high portion of the bat over mid-wicket. Gunathilaka from long on mops it up as they take two more.
Slower length delivery on middle and leg, Mahmudullah tucks it off his hips towards backward square leg. They complete the second with ease. Good running.
Perera is back. He has been exceptional so far. Will Bangladesh take him on?

FOUR! Pradeep shakes his head! He drops it on a shorter length outside off, another slower one. Rahim dances down the track and manages to ramp it down to third man to spoil a good over. 58 needed from 30 balls. Rahim moves to 39 from 19, he holds the key here.
Another slower delivery, right on the money, Mahmudullah stays back and just tucks it in front of mid-wicket to open his account.
Waits for the slower back of a length delivery and then helps it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Full toss and angling in, driven back in the direction of the bowler who gets low and stops it. Has his tails up.
Mahmudullah walks in next.

OUT! Second caught and bowled of the match! Nuwan Pradeep picks up his second of the night and throws the ball in delight! Slower bumper, rising off the deck. Sarkar looks to pull it across the line but the ball gets big on him. He loses the control on the shot as his bottom hand comes off and lobs towards the leg side. Nuwan goes across to his left and takes it easily. 64 required from 34 balls.
Slower delivery and Pradeep is lucky to get away with this. Down the leg side, Rahim gets it off the glove down to fine leg. One run taken.
Nuwan Pradeep to bowl the 15th over.
Slower delivery outside off, Mushfiqur clips it behind square on the leg side to keep strike. 150 up for Bangladesh and they need 65 from 36 balls.
Dabbed fine down to third man for a single.
Good delivery! Sarkar was making room, Chameera slants it away outside off. SS can't reach to it.
SIX! Slammed! Sarkar has smoked this one! He gets underneath a full ball and launches it down to long on for a huge maximum.
Looks to flick it across the line but gets it off the leading edge over backward point. Another single.
Short of a length delivery outside off, slapped over a leaping backward point fielder for a brace.
Dushmantha Chameera is back. He has given 25 runs in 2 overs so far.

FOUR! Drilled! Gunathilaka darts it outside off, Sarkar makes room and absolutely drills it through extra cover. The man in the deep comes across to his left, puts in a dive but couldn't stop it from crossing the fence.
Sees Rahim coming down the track, DG fires it full on off. Jammed out towards cover for a single.
Around middle and off, blocked out.
SIX! SIX! Boom! Strong bottom hand! Loopy delivery around middle and leg, Rahim clears the front leg and dumps it over deep square leg for a maximum. He moves to 25 in just 10 balls.
What has happened? The bowler was about to deliver but he backs out. The next time Rahim pulls out...
Gets to the pitch of the ball and whips it against the turn through mid-wicket for one.
Comes down the track to flick but misses and is hit on the pads.
Danushka Gunathilaka is back on.
FOUR! Now he tries to be cheeky and even that pays off! Walks across to a full length ball and paddle scoops it down to fine leg for a boundary. 10 from the last two, 12 overall from the over.

SIX! What a hit! Seemed to be deceived by the slowness on the ball but still manages to win the battle. Slower length delivery outside off, Rahim makes room but then has to reach out. He throws the kitchen sink at it to get it over backward point for a maximum.
Another good ball! Bowls a slower bumper on middle, Rahim tries ramping it over his opposite number but the ball loops over his head.
On middle and leg, SS clears the front leg and whips it through square leg for just a single.
Clever bowling! Dasun spots Sarkar giving the charge and hence he slants it wide and also changes the pace. Soumya just pushes it towards cover.
Begins with a length delivery on middle and leg, Rahim clips it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Dasun Shanaka into the attack now.
FOUR! Creamed! Fires it full outside off, Sarkar leans ahead and creams it neatly through extra cover for a boundary to end the 12-run over. Exact 100 needed off 54 balls.
Floated ball around middle and off, driven down to long off for one.
Slower through the air outside off, smashed through the gap at cover for an easy brace.
FOUR! Shot! He plays this shot really well! Gets into the position early and nails the reverse sweep off the meat between short third man and point for a boundary.
Very full outside off, Rahim jams it out to the left of the bowler.
Starts off with a flatter leg spinner on middle, Sarkar goes back and punches it down to long on for a single.
Time for leg spin. Jeevan Mendis to bowl now.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for only a single. Terrific over from Thisara again. 2-0-9-1 are his figures so far.
A short ball on middle, Sarkar looks to pull but is cramped for room. Mistimes it to short mid-wicket who comes running in but cannot get there.
WIDE. The batsman watches the bouncer go way above his head. The Umpire signals a wide.
Works it through mid-wicket and gets a single.
Mushfiqur Rahim walks in at number 4, replacing Tamim.

OUT! Caught and bowled! Is that the game? The crowd goes wild. Massive, massive breakthrough. Thisara bends his back and bowls it around middle and leg. Tamim hops and looks to tuck it to the leg side but only manages to pop a simple return catch to the bowler. Tamim falls 3 short of  a half century. The base is set. Can the middle order make use of it? 115 more needed from 63 balls.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. 100 UP FOR BANGLADESH.
A slower ball, Sarkar backs away and slashes hard, only to miss.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single. 10 from that over. The required run rate is 10.55.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Full and outside off, pushed straight to cover.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
On middle and leg, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Welcome back into the attack, mate! Tossed up delivery, Tamim comes down the track and lofts it over extra cover!
Akila Dananjaya is back on.
Outside off, Soumya looks to play the upper cut but misses. Very, very good over from Thisara.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length outside off, steered to third man for a single.
Another short ball, pulled straight to mid-wicket.
Dropped short now, pulled through mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Double change. Thisara Perera into the attack as well.
Works it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and outside off, driven towards mid off.
FOUR! ELEGANT! Full and outside off, Tamim leans and drives it through point. Kusal Perera races to his right from cover and dives but in vain.
FOUR! Nicely done. Waits for the ball to come to him and dabs it to third man for a boundary.
Comes down the track, Gunathilaka fires it wide, Tamim reaches out and drives it towards cover.
Around off, defended watchfully.
Danushka Gunathilaka into the attack. Okay, he is bowling spin tonight. Last time I saw him bowl, he was running in around 20 yards.
Outside off, Sarkar swings but misses. 74/1 in the Powerplay.
Soumya Sarkar walks in at number 3, replacing Das.

OUT! Plumb in front. Das departs and Sri Lanka have an opening. Is this the wicket they needed? Extra pace does the job. Nuwan Pradeep is fast and while using his pace is a better option, playing across the line, that too cheekily, isn't. Das gets down and looks to play the paddle but misses. Is struck right in front and up goes the umpire's finger on the appeal. End of a terrific knock. Has given Bangladesh a chance.
SIX! Excellent shot again, A length ball down the leg side, Das just helps it over backward square leg!
Full and down the leg side, Tamim misses his flick and gets hit on the thigh pads. A leg bye stolen.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
On middle and leg, helped through mid-wicket for a single.
Nuwan Pradeep is back on.
A length ball on middle, Das drags it over mid-wicket and gets a couple. 16 from that over!
A short ball down the leg side, pulled towards fine leg for a run.
A short ball, down the leg side, LD helps it uppishly, attempting the upper cut and gets it down to fine leg. Just a single.
WIDE. Down the leg side, Liton lets t go.
SIX! Amazing timing! Down the leg side, Das flicks it over square leg and the ball clears the ropes!
FOUR! HAMMERED! A short ball, down the leg side, Das swings it over mid-wicket and the ball nearly goes all the way! One bounce and into the ropes.
Down the leg side, helped fine for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera is back on.
SIX! Comes down the track and swings it over the sight screen!
Outside off, tapped to third man for a run.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Outside off, not played at again.
WIDE. Well outside off, left alone.

DROPPED! A tough chance. Full and outside off, Tamim comes down the track and swings it over mid on. Danushka Gunathilaka leaps but the ball brushes his fingertips and rolls towards the long on fence.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Tamim cuts it through point and gets a boundary!
SIX! FETCH THAT! Full and outside off, Das gets down and mows it over mid-wicket for a biggie!
The batsman was beaten and missed the line of the delivery.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Tamim drives it through the covers for a boundary!
Nuwan Pradeep into the attack now.
FOUR! Comes down the track and hits it over the top of the bowler for a boundary!
The batsman dances down the track but decides to defend it.
SIX! Tossed up on middle, Das comes down the track ab swings it over mid-wicket!
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Short and outside off, Liton looks to cut but gets a bottom edge.
Comes down the track but is not to the pitch of the ball and is forced to defend.
Akila Dananjaya into the attack.
On middle and leg, flicked away for one.
Full and outside off, Iqbal slashes it to third man. A run taken.
FOUR! A short ball on middle, Tamim pulls it over square leg and gets a boundary!
Down the leg side, Das missed his flick and the ball hits his pads. A leg bye taken.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for three runs.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Welcome back for the run chase. Could not even take a coffee break. Tamim Iqbal and Liton Das are the openers for Bangladesh. Dushmantha Chameera to start off proceedings to Tamim. Here we go...
